# Equity Theory

Related: [[core-framework]]

## Common Misconceptions
- Equity means equal pay — it means a fair input/outcome ratio
- Myth: people ignore others | Fact: people compare themselves to referents

## Key Components
| Component | Definition |
|---|---|
| Inputs | What the person contributes |
| Outcomes | What the person receives |
